cadenas.Acabado de juntas y remates de un trasdo: Joint finish and finishings of to lining of gypsum board already installed, as work independent. Includes the touching up of the joints with compound and tape, the masillado of heads of screw, the sanding of the joints and the junction finishing with walls and ceiling. Measured per square meter of surface treated.
cadenas.Acabado de superficie de concreto estruc: Finish of surface of structural concrete. Includes the troweling and the finish. Measured per square meter finish.
cadenas.Acabado decorativo tipo estuco veneciano: Decorative finish type Venetian plaster to the lime, applied in several layers to trowel on interior face prepared, with burnishing final that produces the gloss characteristic. Es to finish work puro in the that the result depends almost by complete of the coat of the aplicador, by what conviene ejecutar to sample prior aprobada by the client before of acometer the bay. Includes the preparation and sealing of the substrate, the application of the layers successive with the trowel, the burnishing and the encerado final of protection. Measured in area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².
cadenas.Acabado superficial de la losa mediante: Finish surface of the slab by troweling mechanical and its subsequent curing. Includes the screeding and initial floating, the troweling with alisadora mechanical in the coats necessary up to obtain the texture required according to vaya to receive to floor bonded or exposed remain, the sawing of the joints of shrinkage in the moment suitable, and the curing by curador of membrane or continuous irrigation during the first days, without the which the slab crack by shrinkage plastic by very well concrete placing that is. Measured in surface actually finish.
Finishing and curing of a foundation slab.
cadenas.Acabado y curado de losa de fundación. I: Finish and slab curing of foundation. Includes the troweling and the curing. Measured per square meter completed.
cadenas.Accesorio de baño (toallero, jabonera, e: Bathroom accessory, such as a towel rail or soap dish.
cadenas.Acera de concreto de 8 cm sobre base com: Concrete sidewalk of 8 cm on base compacted, with joints of control and finish slip-resistant, with the slope transversal of discharge. Includes the field layout of ground levels and slopes, the perimeter formwork, the installation of the mesh, the concrete placing and screeding, the finish, the sawing or formation of joints of control to the separation indicated and the curing. Measured in area actually completed.

Temporary electrical supply for the works.

Air source heat pump for domestic hot water.
cadenas.Afirmado de concreto aligerado con anime: Concrete sub-base hollow-core with EPS as fill, for leveling of floors. Includes the field layout, the concrete placing and the leveling. Measured per square meter completed.
cadenas.Afirmado de concreto de 8 cm de espesor: Concrete sub-base of 8 cm of thickness with welded wire mesh of shrinkage, concrete placing on stone base chipping compacted and vapor barrier, with joints of control aserradas. Includes the checking of the base, the installation of the vapor barrier and of the mesh on spacers, the concrete placing and vibration, the screeding level, the floating, the sawing of the joints of control in the moment suitable, that es what prevents the cracking haphazard by shrinkage, and the curing. Measured in area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².
cadenas.Afirmado de concreto sobre terreno, 8 cm: 8 cm concrete bed on the ground.
cadenas.Afirmado de mortero de cemento y arena d: Mortar sub-base of cement and sand of 4 cm of thickness mean, screeding and screeding, completed on slab or base compacted to receive the finish floor. Es the layer that define the level and the flatness permanents of the floor, so that the defects that are left here are dragged to all the subsequent finish. Includes the cleaning and dampened of the substrate, the installation of furring channels to the project level, the laying and screeding of the mortar, the floating of the surface and the curing during the first days. Measured in area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².
cadenas.Agotamiento del agua acumulada en la exc: Depletion of the water acumulada in the excavation by submersible pump with discharge hose to point authorized, for permitir the work in dry. Is applied when appears level water table, leak or rainwater water acumulada. Includes the site of the pump in the low point, the laying of the discharge hose to to point where the tipping no erode nor inunde otras areas, the surveillance of the operation, the cleaning periodic of the filter of suction and the removal of the unit. Measured per hour of operation efectivo of the unit.

Insulation of thermal bridges at beams.
cadenas.Aislamiento de servicio de gas existente: Isolation of the existing gas service.

Insulation of a roof between joists.

Thermal insulation to a roof deck.

cadenas.Aislamiento térmico reflectivo en fachad: Reflective thermal insulation on a facade.

cadenas.Ajuste de puerta descolgada o que roza,: Door adjustment descolgada or that chase, with readjustment of hinges. Includes the checking and the readjustment of the hardware. Measured per unit ajustada.
Adjustment of a door that has dropped on its hinges.

cadenas.Alisado de paramento existente mediante: Face troweling existing by application of compound of leveling to trowel, to correct irregularities smaller, roller frames, textured coating fine or finish debris previous, leaving the flat surface. Es the alternativa economic to the chipping and refriso when the face is sound but with texture or defects surfaces. Includes the scraping of the parts loose, the application of the undercoat fixative, the spreading of the compound in to or two coats according to the defect to correct, the sanding with suction and the touching up final. Measured in area actually completed, deducting openings larger than 1 m².

Extension of a slab as a cantilever or balcony.
cadenas.Ampliación de losa existente en voladizo: Extension of existing slab in cantilever or formation of balcony, with connection to the structure by anchorage chemical of the continuity bars. The connection es the point critical: to cantilever work with the steel in the upper face and with the length of anchorage complete inside of the existing slab, so that the depth and the position of the drillings no admiten approaches. Includes the shoring, the bush-hammering and cleaning of the existing edge, the drilling and anchorage chemical of the bars, the reinforcement, the formwork on shores, the concrete placing and vibration, the curing and the removal of shoring stepped. Measured in area actually completed.
Anchoring of a bar with epoxy resin.
cadenas.Anclaje de barra de acero en elemento de: Bar anchorage of steel in concrete element existing by resin epoxy two-component inyectada in drilling, for connection of elements news to the existing structure. Includes the field layout of the point avoiding the existing reinforcement by prior detection, the drilling with the diameter and the depth especificados by the manufacturer of the resin, the cleaning of the taladro by soplado and brushing repetidos, operation of the that depends by complete the capacity of the anchorage and that es the that more is omitted in construction site, the injection of the resin from the undercoat, the introduction of the bar with giro and the compliance of the curing time before of cargarla. Measured per unit actually completed.
cadenas.Anclaje de estructura de techo a la losa: Anchoring of a roof structure to the slab.
cadenas.Anclaje químico de barra de acero en con: Chemical anchoring of a steel bar in concrete.
Chemical anchoring of a bar in concrete.
cadenas.Anclaje químico o mecánico de la estruct: Anchorage chemical or mechanical of the ceiling structure to the slab or support beam, with anchorage bolts. Includes the drilling and the fastening.
cadenas.Andamio colgante o silleta para trabajos: Swing stage for work on a facade.
cadenas.Andamio colgante para trabajos en fachad: Swing stage for work on a facade.
cadenas.Andamio interior móvil o sobre borriquet: Mobile scaffold or trestle scaffold indoors.
cadenas.Andamio interior rodante o plataforma so: Mobile indoor scaffold or trestle platform for work at height indoors, such as ceilings, plaster on high walls and painting. Includes delivery of the equipment to site, its erection and leveling, the installation of guardrails where the working height requires it, successive repositioning and height adjustment through the working day, dismantling and removal. Measured by the area of ceiling or wall surface actually reached from the scaffold.
cadenas.Andamio tubular de fachada con plataform: Tubular scaffold to a facade with working platforms.
cadenas.Andamio tubular de fachada, montaje, alq: Tubular scaffold to a facade, including erection, monthly hire and dismantling.
cadenas.Andamio tubular metálico apoyado en fach: Tubular steel scaffold bearing on the facade, with working platforms, guardrails, toe boards and an internal access stair, including its erection, the first month on hire and its dismantling. Includes the prior assessment of the bearing and of the ties to the facade, erection by competent personnel, the installation of the collective protective measures, inspection of the whole assembly before it is brought into service and after any modification, orderly dismantling and removal of the material. It does not include hire beyond the first month, which is priced in the following item. Measured by the area of facade actually covered by the scaffold.
cadenas.Apeo de cubierta o techo durante trabajo: Shoring of a roof during strengthening work. Includes placing the shores. Measured per square meter shored.
Shoring of a lintel while an opening is formed.
cadenas.Apeo de dintel durante la apertura de va: Shoring of a lintel while the opening is formed. Includes placing the shores. Measured per linear meter shored.
Shoring to the formwork of a beam.
cadenas.Apeo de escalera existente durante traba: Shoring of an existing stair during strengthening work. Includes placing the shores. Measured per linear meter shored.
cadenas.Apeo de fachada durante demolición parci: Shoring of a facade during partial demolition.
Shoring of a facade during partial demolition. Includes placing the shores and the bracing. Measured per square meter shored.
cadenas.Apeo de losa con puntales metálicos y du: Shoring of a slab with steel shores and spreader beams.
Shoring of a slab with steel shores and spreader beams. Includes placing the shores and the bracing. Measured per square meter shored.
Shoring of a slab with shores and spreader beams.
cadenas.Apeo de losa con torres de carga metálic: Shoring of a slab with steel load towers. Includes erecting the towers. Measured per square meter shored.
Shoring of a slab with load towers.
Shoring of a beam with steel shores.
cadenas.Apeo de viga con puntales metálicos. Inc: Shoring of a beam with steel shores. Includes placing the shores and the bracing. Measured per linear meter shored.
Shoring of a beam with shores.
cadenas.Apeo o arriostramiento provisional de mu: Temporary shoring or bracing of a wall using raking shores with spreader beams, to stabilize it against thrust or overturning while work goes on around it. Must follow the instruction of the engineer or architect in charge. Includes setting out the bearing points, preparing the spreader bases on the floor, erecting and loading the raking shores, periodically checking stability and tightness, and dismantling once the element has been made good. Measured over the area of wall actually shored.
Temporary shoring or bracing of a wall.
cadenas.Apeo provisional de losa mediante puntal: Temporary shoring of a slab with telescopic steel shores on spreader beams at head and base, to support the structure while demolition, openings or strengthening are carried out. It must be carried out to a calculation or to the express instruction of the responsible professional, who defines the spacing and the load on the shores. Includes field layout of the shoring grid, placing the spreader beams, erecting and loading the shores without forcing the structure, checking plumb and bearing, maintenance and inspection during the works, and the staged removal of the shoring once the specified strength has been reached. Measured by the area of slab actually shored.
cadenas.Apeo provisional de viga mediante puntal: Temporary shoring of a beam with telescopic steel shores and a spreader beam at the head, placed on both sides of the element being worked on. It must be carried out to a calculation or to the instruction of the responsible professional. Includes field layout of the shoring points, placing the spreader beams, erecting and progressively loading the shores, checking that the load is transferred to a bearing of sufficient capacity at the level below, inspection during the works and the staged removal of the shoring. Measured by the length of beam actually shored.
cadenas.Apeo y soporte de encofrado de viga. Inc: Shoring and formwork substrate of beam. Includes the installation of shores. Measured per shored square meter.
cadenas.Apertura de cata de reconocimiento en pa: Exploratory opening in a wall, roughly 30x30 cm, to identify the type of substrate, its thickness or the presence of concealed services before the work is designed. Includes scanning beforehand with an electronic detector so as not to drill into a live pipe or cable, carefully breaking out layer by layer until the element being sought is exposed, photographic recording of what is found, and patching the opening with repair mortar so the face is left ready for its finish. cadenas.Suministro y colocación de ventana proye: Supply and installation of window awning window of aluminum with glass. Includes the installation of the frame, the glazing and the sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de ventanal de v: Supply and installation of ventanal of fixed glass interior, with profile of fastening. Includes the installation of the profile and the glazing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de vidrio blinda: Supply and installation of glass blindado of safety, with sealing. Includes the measuring and the installation. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de vidrio decora: Supply and installation of decorative glass grabado or arenado, with sealing. Includes the measuring and the installation. Measured per square meter installed.

Supply and installation of glass in joinery.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de vidrio esmeri: Supply and installation of glass grinding in division interior, for privacy. Includes the measuring and the installation. Measured per square meter installed.

Supply and installation of glass safety laminated in access door. Includes the measuring, the cutting and the installation. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de vidrio templa: Supply and installation of glass tempered in existing carpentry. Includes the measuring, the cutting and the installation with sealing. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación de viga de mader: Supply and installation of beam of structural lumber. Includes the installation and the fastening. Measured per linear meter installed.
Supply and installation of lumber beam laminated. Includes the installation and the fastening. Measured per linear meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación del botiquín de: Supply and installation of the site first aid kit, stocked and replenished during the works. Measured per first aid kit installed and maintained.
cadenas.Suministro y colocación del conjunto de: Supply and installation of the set of safety signage for the site: warning, mandatory, prohibition and emergency signs, barrier tape and cones. Includes siting each sign at the point where the risk is real and visible before anyone is exposed to it, fixing the signs, delimiting the risk areas and maintaining and replacing them during the works. Measured per set of signage installed.
cadenas.Suministro y dotación de botiquín de pri: Supply and stocking of a site first aid kit, with its replenishment.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de bajante de aguas: Supply and downspout installation of waters rainwater in PVC, with its clamps, elbows and connection to the red of drainage. Includes the field layout of the route, the fastening of the clamps to the face with the separation indicated, the installation of the sections with its start elbows and of foot, the sealing of the joints and the connection to the manhole or tipping point, avoiding the discharge free against the floor that erodes and salpica the facade. Measured in length actually installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de baranda o pasama: Supply and railing installation or steel handrail stainless with its studs, tubes and accessories of joint, anclados to the floor or to the edge of the slab. cadenas.Suministro y montaje de canal de recogid: Supply and installation of collection channel of waters rainwater in eaves, with its substrates, joints, covers and connection to downspout. cadenas.Suministro y montaje de cercha de madera: Supply and truss installation of lumber. Includes the installation and the fastening. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de columna metálica: Supply and column installation metal. Includes the hoisting, the installation and the fastening. Measured per linear meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de correas metálica: Supply and purlin installation metal of profile conformado for the substrate of the roof, fixed to the structure main by fasteners or welding, with its tensioners and spacers. cadenas.Suministro y montaje de correas o viguet: Supply and purlin installation or lumber joists for the roof substrate or intermediate floor, fixed to the structure main with hardware or nailing. cadenas.Suministro y montaje de escalera metálic: Supply and stair installation metal with railing. Includes the installation of the stair and the railing. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and stair installation metal with treads of grille. Includes the installation. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and stair installation metal of caracol. Includes the installation. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and stair installation metal of emergency. Includes the installation. Measured per square meter installed.

Supply and stair installation structural metal formed by zancas of profile laminated, treads and landings, with its anchorages to the structure. Does not include railings nor the finish of the tread. Measured in weight actually installed.
Supply and stair installation structural metal. Includes the installation and the fastening. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de estructura de ma: Supply and structure installation of lumber aserrada formed by beams, pairs and tie rods, with joints completeds by metal hardware or ensambles traditionals. Includes the reception and verification of the cross-section, the damp and the defect absence that comprometan the capacity, the cutting and labra of the pieces, the submitted and adjustment of the joints, the hoisting and installation with temporary shoring, the fastening permanent, the checking geometric of the assembly and the adjustment of contraflechas. Does not include the treatment preservative nor the hardware, that are priced separately. Measured in volume of lumber actually installed.

Supply and structure installation of ceiling lumber formed by pairs, purlins and tie rods, with joints by metal hardware, and its treatment preservative. Includes the selection of the pieces verifying cross-section and defect absence, the cutting and labra, the hoisting and installation with temporary shoring, the fastening with hardware, the application of the preservative in all the faces and very especialmente in the ends and support areas, and the checking of levels and slopes. Measured in area actually completed.
Supply and erection of a wood structure.
Supply and structure installation of lumber. Includes the installation and the fastening. Measured per cubic meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de estructura metál: Supply and structure installation metal with anti-corrosion protection complete. Includes the installation and the protection. Measured per square meter installed.

Supply and structure installation metal of ceiling formed by trusses, beams and profile purlins laminated or conformado, with its connections welded or screwings and its primer anti-corrosion. Includes the verification of the supports and of the boards base, the hoisting and submitted of the pieces, the temporary bracing during the installation, the execution of the joints permanents, the checking geometric of levels and slopes and the touch-up of the anti-corrosion protection in the areas affected by the welding. Measured in weight actually installed.
Supply and structure installation smaller metal for canopy, with profiles soldados. Includes the fabrication, the installation and the anchorage. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and structure installation metal for roof. Includes the installation and the fastening. Measured per square meter installed.

Supply and structure installation metal for light ceiling. Includes the installation and the fastening. Measured per square meter installed.
Supply and structure installation metal. Includes the hoisting, the installation and the screwing. Measured per kilogram installed.

Supply and lining installation of board of reinforced cement with fiber on structure, as substrate of the tiling in shower area or bathtub. Includes the structure, the screwing of the board, the joint treatment with mesh and the sealing of the joints prior to the waterproofing and the tiling. Measured per square meter of lining finished.

Supply and lining installation of gypsum board of 12,5 mm on battens fixed to the wall, creating to chamber minimum for the passage of installations. Includes the fastening of the battens to plumb with plugs, the passage of the installations by the chamber, the screwing of the board and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter of lining finished.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de forro ignífugo d: Supply and lining installation fire-resistant of gypsum board resistant to the fire of 15 mm, on metal structure, for protection of installations, ducts or structure. Includes the structure, the screwing of the board, the joint treatment and the sealing of the steps of installations. Measured per square meter of lining finished.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de interruptor dife: Supply and installation of residual current device of high sensibilidad in the board, with its connection and test. Es the device that protects to the personas face to the electrical contact: the thermomagnetics protegen the installation, no to quien the toca. Its installation es required in circuits of bathrooms, kitchens and exterior. Includes the installation on rail, the wiring of phases and neutral observing the orden, the checking of that no neutral of the circuit protected is joined waters below with other circuit, error that causes trippings intermitentes imposibles of diagnosticar, and the test with the button of test and with dimension unit. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de interruptor term: Supply and switch installation thermomagnetic in the board, with its connection and identification. The capacity of the switch must corresponder to the gauge of the conductor that protects, no to the consumption of the unit: to switch oversized protect leaves the cable and it convierte in the fusible of the circuit. Includes the installation on rail, the connection of phase and its tightening to the pair, the labeling of the circuit in the panel schedule and the tripping test. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de llave de paso de: Supply and valve installation of passage of esfera of PPR of 20 mm, recessed in face, for the cutting sectorizado of the water supply. Includes opening of the opening, installation alternating in the pipe by heat fusion, checking of the maniobrabilidad of the volante, watertightness test and patching of the face, leaving the embellecedor flush. Measured per unit installed and tested.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de marco y contrama: Supply and installation of metal frame and subframe in door opening, embedded in the masonry or anclado to the face. The subframe is placed during the survey of the wall and remains embedded, so that its field layout and plumbing all determine the subsequent carpentry: to subframe poorly plumbing no is corrected after. Includes the field layout, the plumbing and temporary bracing, the solid of the patillas in the masonry, the anti-corrosion protection and the installation of the permanent frame. Measured in length of perimeter of opening.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de pasamanos de mad: Supply and handrail installation of lumber on existing railing or directly on wall by substrates. Includes the field layout of the height constant following the slope of the stair, the cutting and joint of the sections with empalmes concealed, the installation of the substrates with the separation that prevents the bending, the fastening of the handrail, the sanding of the joint up to hacerla imperceptible to the tacto, that es as is perceived to handrail, and the varnishing. Measured in length actually installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de placa de yeso la: Supply and installation of gypsum board of 12,5 mm on battens to level to wall and conceal installations exposed without recurrir to construction site damp. Includes the field layout, the fastening of the battens, the passage and protection of the installations, the screwing of the board and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter of face leveled.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de portón corredizo: Supply and installation of gate metal sliding for access vehicular or pedestrian, with its frame, rail, ruedas, guides and stops. Includes the fabrication or reception of the frame, the execution or checking of the rail of rodadura perfectly leveled, already that any desnivel makes that the gate corra only or jams, the installation of the ruedas and guides uppers, the adjustment of the route and the stops, the primer anti-corrosion and the checking of operation. Measured in area actually completed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de protector contra: Supply and protective installation against overvoltage transient type 1 (class I) in the board main, with its connection to earth. Includes the choice of the modelo according to the corriente of discharge foreseen, the installation in the carril of the board, the connection of the conductors of phase, neutral and earth with the section indicated and it more cortos possible, and the operation test. Measured per unit installed.

Supply and protective installation against overvoltage transient type 2 (class II) in board secundario of distribution, with its connection to earth. Includes the installation in the carril of the board, the connection of the conductors with the section indicated and it more cortos possible, and the operation test. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de puerta corrediza: Supply and door installation sliding of closet with its upper rail and lower, trolleys, leaves and handles. Includes the leveling of the upper rail, that es the that supports the weight and of the that depends that the leaves no come loose nor rocen, the installation of the lower guide, the hung of the leaves with its trolleys adjustable, the adjustment of the verticalidad and of the lap between leaves and the installation of stops and felpas. Measured in area actually completed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de rampa metálica e: Supply and ramp installation structural metal. Includes the installation. Measured per square meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de tablero eléctric: Supply and board installation electrical with protections. Includes the installation and the connection. Measured per unit installed.

Supply and board installation electrical of recessed distribution or surface-mounted, with its barraje of neutral and earth, and reserve space for extensions. Includes the field layout in point accessible and no blocked, the opening of the opening and the installation flush, the entrance tidy of the conduits, the installation of the barraje, the connection of the circuits with the conductor peinado and identificado, the installation of the panel schedule of circuits labeling, that es what allows to any localizar to failure without ir testing, and the continuity test and insulation. Measured per board installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de tragante, boquil: Supply and gully installation, nozzle or roof floor drain with its grille guardahojas, integrated in the waterproofing. Es the point by the that sale all the water of the roof and also the that more failure, already whether by obstruction or by to sealing deficiente of the junction with the layer. Includes the formation of the recess in the low point, the installation of the piece with its ala embedded between the layers of waterproofing, the sealing of the junction, the installation of the grille and the checking of discharge by test with water. Measured per unit installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de trasdosado autop: Supply and lining installation self-supporting with double gypsum board of 12,5 mm, for increase the acoustic mass and the strength to the impact. Includes the structure separate of the wall, the screwing of the two boards with joints alternadas, the joint treatment in both layers and the junction finishing. Measured per square meter of lining finished.

Supply and lining installation self-supporting of gypsum board with reinforcement interior of lumber or metal profile, for the subsequent anchorage of loadings as cabinets hungs, televisores or shelvings. Includes the structure, the installation of the reinforcement in the position foreseen for the loadings, the screwing of the board and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter of lining finished.

Supply and lining installation self-supporting of gypsum board of 12,5 mm with panel of mineral wool of 60 mm in the chamber, for thermal insulation and acoustic. Includes the structure separate of the wall, the installation of the panel of wool in the chamber without comprimirlo, the screwing of the board and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter of lining finished.

Supply and lining installation self-supporting of gypsum board of high hardness of 12,5 mm, for faces sometidos to impact and areas of traffic as corridors and common areas. Includes the structure separate of the wall, the screwing of the board and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter of lining finished.

Supply and lining installation self-supporting of gypsum board standard of 12,5 mm, on steel structure galvanized separate of the wall, without insulation. Includes the field layout of the structure with each studs 60 cm, the fastening of start channels to the floor and to the ceiling with perimeter band of watertightness, the screwing of the board, the joint treatment with compound and tape, and the junction finishing with walls and ceiling. Measured per square meter of lining finished.

Supply and lining installation self-supporting of gypsum board resistant to the damp of 12,5 mm, for bathrooms, kitchens and premises with condensation. Includes the structure separate of the wall, the screwing of the board, the joint treatment with compound and tape apropiadas for damp and the junction finishing. Measured per square meter of lining finished.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de trasdosado de me: Supply and lining installation of party wall on wall medianero, with structure self-supporting, panel of mineral wool of 60 mm and gypsum board of 12,5 mm, for aislar of the noise and the damp of the vecino. Includes the perimeter band, the installation of the panel, the screwing of the board and the joint treatment. Measured per square meter of lining finished.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de viga de amarre m: Supply and beam installation of metal tying. Includes the installation and the fastening. Measured per linear meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje de viga metálica. I: Supply and beam installation metal. Includes the hoisting, the installation and the fastening. Measured per linear meter installed.
cadenas.Suministro y montaje del juego de acceso: Supply and installation of the accessory matching and hardware complementarios of the furniture: handles, organizers, shut-off hinges smooth, systems of elevation and stops. Includes the field layout, the pretaladrado with template to guarantee the alignment of the handles in all the faces, that es what is noticed to simple exposed in to cabinet well finished, the installation and the adjustment final of shut-offs and amortiguadores. Measured per matching installed.
cadenas.Suministro y tendido de bajante de cobre: Supply and downspout laying of copper bare from the captador up to the grounding, with its grapas of fastening separates of the face. Includes the field layout of the route more corto and straight, the fastening of the grapas, the laying of the conductor without dobleces closed and the connection in both ends. Measured per linear meter of downspout installed.
cadenas.Suministro y tendido de conductor captad: Supply and conductor laying captador of copper bare on ridge and perimeter of roof, with its substrates of fastening. Includes the field layout of the route, the fastening of the substrates, the laying of the conductor and the joints to the downspouts. Measured per linear meter of conductor installed.
cadenas.Suministro y transporte de arena lavada: Supply and sand transport washed to construction site. Includes the supply and the transport. Measured per cubic meter supplied.
cadenas.Suministro y transporte de gravilla a ob: Supply and gravel transport to construction site. Includes the supply and the transport. Measured per cubic meter supplied.
cadenas.Suministro y transporte de material de p: Supply and cartage of imported fill to the site.
Supply and transport of material of borrow to construction site. Includes the supply and the transport. Measured per cubic meter supplied.
cadenas.Suministro y transporte de piedra picada: Supply and stone transport chipping to construction site. Includes the supply and the transport. Measured per cubic meter supplied.
cadenas.Suministro, corte, doblado, armado y col: Supply, cutting, bending, reinforcement and installation of reinforcing steel in deformed rebars of limit elastic 4.200 kg/cm2 in columns, according to the flats of cutting list. The productivity by kilogram es of the low more of the construction site steel by the work in vertical and by the cantidad of stirrups. Includes the cutting and bar bending and stirrups, the reinforcement of the canasta with the separation of stirrups indicated and its reduction in the containment areas of the ends, the tying with wire in all the cruces, the lap with the waiting of the foundation or of the lower level observing the length foreseen, the installation of spacers in the four faces and the plumbing and bracing of the reinforcement before of the formwork. Measured in weight of steel actually installed.

Supply, cutting, bending, reinforcement and installation of reinforcing steel in deformed rebars of limit elastic 4.200 kg/cm2 in footings and bases of foundation, according to the flats of cutting list. Includes the cutting and bending in construction site or the recibo of the steel already elaborado, the reinforcement of the grilles with wire tying in all the cruces of the perimeter and alternate in the interior, the installation of spacers to guarantee the covering especificado by all the faces, the bracing of the reinforcement for that no shifts during the concrete placing and the review of the cutting list before of autorizar the concrete. Measured in weight of steel actually installed, without incluir despuntes nor laps no foreseens in the cutting list.

Supply, cutting, bending, reinforcement and installation of reinforcing steel in deformed rebars in concrete stair reinforcement, according to the flats of cutting list. Includes the cutting and bending, the reinforcement of the mat main of the slab sloping with its distribution reinforcement, the arrangement of the reinforcements in the quiebres of the geometry where the layout of the steel must respetar the direction of the tensions, the anchorage in the start supports and arrival, the tying with wire and the installation of spacers. Measured in weight of steel actually installed.

Supply, cutting, bending, reinforcement and installation of reinforcing steel in deformed rebars in slab of foundation, in lower grilles and upper according to the flats of cutting list. Includes the cutting and bending, the reinforcement of the grilles with wire tying, the installation of spacers lowers and of ridge tiles or substrates that mantienen the mat upper in its level during the concrete placing, the edge reinforcements and of corner, and the review of the cutting list and of the covering before of autorizar the concrete. Measured in weight of steel actually installed.

Supply, cutting, bending, reinforcement and installation of reinforcing steel in deformed rebars in solid slab, in lower grilles and upper according to the flats of cutting list. Includes the cutting and bending, the reinforcement of the grilles with wire tying, the installation of spacers lowers and of ridge tiles that sostienen the mat upper in its level, the reinforcements on the supports and in the opening edges, and the touching up of the position of the reinforcement inmediatamente before of the concrete placing. Measured in weight of steel actually installed.

Supply, cutting, bending, reinforcement and installation of reinforcing steel in deformed rebars in retaining wall, according to the flats of cutting list. Includes the cutting and bending, the reinforcement of the two vertical grilles with its hooks of start solapados to the waiting of the foundation, the tying with wire, the installation of spacers in both faces to guarantee the covering, the edge reinforcements and of corner, and the checking of that the mat of the lado of the ground remains in the face tensioned correct, error frecuente and of consecuencias graves. Measured in weight of steel actually installed.

Supply, cutting, bending, reinforcement and installation of reinforcing steel in deformed rebars in screen or structural wall of concrete reinforcement, in two vertical grilles, according to the flats of cutting list. Includes the cutting and bending, the reinforcement of both grilles with its vertical bars and horizontal, the installation of the hooks or grapas of joint between grilles that impiden its separation during the concrete placing, the lap with the waiting of the lower level, the arrangement of the edge reinforcements and of the containment elements in the ends, the installation of spacers in both faces and the review of the cutting list. Measured in weight of steel actually installed.

Supply, cutting, bending, reinforcement and installation of reinforcing steel in deformed rebars in brace beams, according to the flats of cutting list. The beam reinforcement requires more time by kilogram that the of footing by the installation of the stirrups and by the work in trench estrecha. Includes the cutting and bar bending and stirrups, the reinforcement of the canasta with the separation of stirrups indicated and its reduction in the containment areas joint to the supports, the tying with wire, the installation of spacers by the four faces, the anchorage or lap with the waiting of the footings and the review of the cutting list before of the concrete placing. Measured in weight of steel actually installed.

Supply, cutting, bending, reinforcement and installation of reinforcing steel in deformed rebars in beams, according to the flats of cutting list. Includes the cutting and bar bending and stirrups, the reinforcement of the canasta with the separation of stirrups indicated and its reduction in the containment areas joint to the supports, the arrangement of the upper reinforcement on the supports and of the lower in the center of the opening in accordance to the diagrama of moments, the tying with wire, the installation of spacers, the anchorage in the nodes with the columns and the review of the cutting list before of autorizar the concrete placing. Measured in weight of steel actually installed.

Supply, cutting, bending, reinforcement and installation of the canasta of reinforcing steel of the pile, with its bars longitudinales and its zuncho helicoidal. Includes the reinforcement of the canasta in surface, the installation of spacers circulares that centran the canasta inside of the drilling and garantizan the covering, the hoisting and descent controlled of the canasta inside of the pile without that roce the walls and arrastre earth, its suspension to the level correct during the concrete placing and the arrangement of the waiting of connection with the header. Measured in weight of steel actually installed.
cadenas.Suministro, instalación y configuración: Supply, installation and initial configuration of the central home automation or controlador main, with its source of supply and its connection to the red local. Includes the field layout of the installation point accessible, the fastening of the unit, the supply and connection of red, the start-up in hour and allocation of direction, and the verification of that the central is communicated with the modules foreseens. Measured per central installed.
cadenas.Suministro, izado y montaje de estructur: Supply, hoisting and structure installation metal of steel formed by profiles laminateds, with its cartelas, rigidizadores and elements of connection, installed by welding and structural fasteners. Includes the reception and verification of the material against the flats of taller, the field layout and checking of the position of the boards base, the hoisting with crane and the submitted of the pieces, the plumbing and temporary leveling by bracings and installation screws, the execution of the joints permanents, the verification geometric of the assembly installed and the removal of the elements temporary. Does not include the anti-corrosion protection nor the protection against fire. Measured in weight of structure actually installed.
cadenas.Sustitución de bajante de aguas lluvias: Replacement of rainwater downspout rainwater damaged, with removal and installation of the new. Includes the fastening and the accessories.
cadenas.Sustitución de canal de recogida de agua: Replacement of collection channel of waters rainwater damaged, with removal and installation of the new. Includes the fastening and the finishings.
Replacement of a rainwater collection channel.
Replacement of the ridge of a roof.
cadenas.Sustitución de cumbrera o remate superio: Replacement of ridge or upper finishing of roof damaged, with removal and installation of the new piece. Includes the setting and the sealing.
cadenas.Sustitución de ductos de ventilación, pa: Replacement of ducts of ventilation, to improve the efficiency of the system.
cadenas.Sustitución de equipo de climatización p: Replacement of unit of air conditioning by uno of high efficiency, with connection and commissioning. The unit is selected by the client.
cadenas.Sustitución de junta de estanqueidad de: Replacement of a window weather seal.
cadenas.Sustitución de la cerradura de una puert: Replacement of the lock of to door, with removal of the previous and installation of the new. Includes the removal and the installation. Measured per unit sustituida.
cadenas.Sustitución de la junta de estanqueidad: Replacement of the watertightness joint of the windows, to improve the hermeticidad.
cadenas.Sustitución de luminarias por LED de alt: Replacement of luminaires by LED of high efficiency, with connection. The luminaire is selected by the client.
Replacement of light fixtures with LED.
